problems.q: As used in the sentence, what does "abundant" most nearly mean? "The garden had an abundant supply of tomatoes, so many that we gave bags away."
As used in the sentence, what does "vacant" most nearly mean? "Unlike the crowded front room, the back office was vacant."
As used in the sentence, what does "feeble" most nearly mean? "After being sick for a week, the puppy was feeble and could barely stand."
As used in the sentence, what does "reluctant" most nearly mean? "She was reluctant to dive in; she stood at the edge for ten minutes before jumping."
Which context clue type is used here, and what does "hazardous" mean? "The icy road was hazardous, or dangerous, for drivers."
The prefix "un-" means "not." What does "unhappy" mean?
What does the prefix "re-" mean, as in "rebuild"?
What does "preview" mean, using its prefix "pre-"?
Which prefix means "wrongly," as in "misread"?
What does "submarine" describe, using the prefix "sub-" (under)?
problems.answer: a craft that goes under water

problems.q: The suffix "-less" means "without." What does "fearless" mean?
The suffix "-ful" means "full of." What does "joyful" mean?
What does the suffix "-er" mean in the word "teacher"?
What does "readable" mean, using the suffix "-able"?
The suffix "-ly" turns a word into an adverb. What does "quickly" mean?
The root "bio" means "life." What is "biology"?
What does the root "tele" mean, as in "telephone" and "telescope"?
What does "transport" mean, using the root "port" (carry)?
problems.answer: to carry from place to place

problems.q: The root "spect" means "look." What does "inspect" mean?
What does "audible" mean, using the root "aud" (hear)?
Which word means MOST NEARLY the same as "brave": glad, courageous, or tired?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of "ancient": old, modern, or huge?
Which word means MOST NEARLY the same as "enormous": tiny, huge, or quick?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of "increase": raise, decrease, or grow?
Which word is the OPPOSITE of "abundant": plentiful, scarce, or rich?
What does "bark" mean here? "The rough bark of the oak tree scratched my hand."
problems.answer: the outer covering of a tree

problems.q: What does "light" mean here? "The box was so light that a child could lift it."
What does "trunk" mean here? "We loaded the suitcases into the trunk of the car."
problems.answer: the storage space of a car

problems.q: What does "current" mean here? "The strong current pulled the swimmers downstream."
What does "fair" mean here? "The referee made a fair call that both teams accepted."
Which word has a POSITIVE connotation for a thin person: slender or scrawny?
Which word has a NEGATIVE connotation: confident or arrogant?
Order from WEAKEST to STRONGEST: hot, warm, scorching.
Which word makes a group sound WILD and THREATENING: crowd or mob?
Which word would a writer choose to make a smell sound PLEASANT: fragrance or stench?
What does "analyze" mean?
problems.answer: to study the parts of something closely

problems.q: What does "infer" mean?
problems.answer: to figure out something not stated directly, using clues

problems.q: What does "evidence" mean?
problems.answer: facts or details that support an idea

problems.q: What does "objective" mean?
